text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear thinking. First, time management is essential: create a realistic schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you spend your energy where it matters most. Third, scope management means being honest about what you can finish. If a task is too big, reduce it or ask for help instead of doing everything badly. Finally, communication is key. Tell your team or manager early if a deadline is at risk. People prefer bad news early to surprises later. With these four habits, deadlines become less stressful and more manageable.
